decision_order: If the user asks to evaluate/revise an existing output, choose evaluation_revision.
If the requested final thing is a physical artifact (statue, bust, relief, vessel, tile, embroidered object), choose artifact_transform.
If the dominant challenge is multi-panel/layout/text hierarchy, choose storyboard_or_grid or design_layout.
If a living subject is being placed in a bounded historical period, choose historical_portrait.
If a reference image is being changed while remaining an image/photo/illustration, choose reference_transform.
If a pictorial/craft method is the main transformation and no stronger route applies, choose art_style_transform.
rule: Choose one primary route. Era/site/genre and art-method modules are context, not competing primary routes.
